messages: A mixed infection means resistance present in only one strain may appear as a minority variant (step 05/09); minority resistance calls should be interpreted with this in mind.

Method: MixInfect-style heterozygous-site count re-implemented in this pipeline (MixInfect and QuantTB are not available as validated containers). The threshold is provisional until validation with in-silico mixtures (V4).

tools.name: bcftools
tools.command: bcftools mpileup -q 20 (and -q 46 for the OmegaTB rule) -a AD,ADF,ADR | bcftools call -m -v -V indels; low_confidence_mask.bed applied afterwards
